_comment: Every supplier the puller knows about.
Adding a Shopify store is one entry here and no code — the whole platform
serves /products.json?limit=250&page=N with variants, SKUs, prices, grams
and images. A surprising share of Indian electronics and parts retailers
run on it, which is why this is a table rather than a switch statement.
`prefix` namespaces the SKU. It must be unique and must never change once
a source has been imported: the importer keys updates on `sku`, so editing
a prefix turns every future run into a duplicate catalogue rather than an
To check whether a new site qualifies:
A JSON object with a `products` array means it will work as-is.

onlyscrews.note: Fasteners, magnets, bearings. product_type is mostly empty, so mapping leans on titles.

robocraze.note: Robotics and sensors. Real product_type values — maps far better than onlyscrews.

robu.note: ~110k products. Cloudflare-fronted, so it goes through curl and one request per product page — hours, not minutes. Its own adapter because the data comes from JSON-LD, not an API.
